profile.name: Rohit Pal
profile.title: Full-Stack Web Developer & Software Engineering Student
profile.subtitle: Pre-final year B.Tech CSE Student @ United Institute of Technology, Prayagraj
profile.aboutShort: Pre-final year Computer Science student at United Institute of Technology with a strong interest in full-stack web development. I enjoy designing and developing web applications using modern technologies while learning through real projects, team collaborations, and hackathons. My goal is to build software that is reliable, secure, scalable, and easy to use.
profile.aboutLong: I am a Pre-final year Computer Science student at United Institute of Technology with a strong focus on full-stack web engineering. Beyond academics, I am actively involved in developer communities like TechEraa, UDTech India, and Cloud Junction. I am also a Wikimedia Open Source Contributor working with Vue.js design systems (Codex), Gerrit, and Phabricator, and have completed an official state law enforcement Cyber Security Fellowship with Amroha Police Cyber Crime Cell (UP Police).

keyDomains.name: OSINT & SIGINT
keyDomains.desc: Digital reconnaissance, information gathering, and threat intelligence fundamentals.

keyDomains.name: Digital Forensics
keyDomains.desc: Evidence preservation, forensic methodology, Android analysis, and investigation workflows.

keyDomains.name: Malware Analysis
keyDomains.desc: APK analysis, sandboxing, static/dynamic binary auditing, and C2 server mapping.

keyDomains.name: CDR & IPDR
keyDomains.desc: Understanding call records, IP detail records, cell tower logs, and cybercrime links.

keyDomains.name: Cyber Laws & Privacy
keyDomains.desc: IT Act 2000 Section 66 offenses, DPDP Act 2023, Puttaswamy privacy ruling, and court evidence rules.

keyDomains.name: Mobile Security
keyDomains.desc: Android security, Genymotion-based analysis, hardware chip-off forensics, and evidence preservation.

dailyOperations.title: Registration, Welcome Kit & Program Orientation
dailyOperations.sessions: Credential verification at SVU Amroha, welcome kit collection, briefing on operational discipline.
dailyOperations.findings: Established baseline: law enforcement collaboration starts with operational discipline and accountability.

dailyOperations.title: Inauguration & Threat Ecosystem
dailyOperations.sessions: Official inauguration ceremony with Amroha Police officials; analyzed financial scam networks and NCCRP portal linkages.
dailyOperations.findings: Understood the strategic role of cyber investigators: bridging human awareness, system hardening, and legal reporting loops.

dailyOperations.title: OSINT Reconnaissance & Cyber Psychology
dailyOperations.sessions: Studied psychological manipulation tactics in scams; practiced passive recon with Maltego, Shodan, Google Dorks, DeHashed, FotoForensics.
dailyOperations.findings: Vulnerabilities often lie in residual digital footprints. Mastered querying open registers without exposing endpoints.

dailyOperations.title: Cyber Laws, Research Methodology & AI
dailyOperations.sessions: Studied IT Act 2000, Section 66 offenses, digital evidence rules; explored ML/Generative AI in threat log anomaly detection.
dailyOperations.findings: Developing admissible court case files requires combining statutory laws, scientific methodology, and AI data parsing.

dailyOperations.title: Malware Analysis & Digital Evidence Imaging
dailyOperations.sessions: Android APK decompilation, C2 server mapping, bit-stream dumps, write-blockers, hash verification (MD5/SHA-256) standards.
dailyOperations.findings: Evidence integrity must be protected at every step. Hash signatures trace threat agents and maintain court admissibility.

dailyOperations.title: SOC Operations & Bug Bounty Hunting
dailyOperations.sessions: SOC architecture, SIEM & EDR platforms (Wazuh, Elastic, Wireshark, VirusTotal); bug bounty methodology (HackerOne, Bugcrowd).
dailyOperations.findings: Continuous monitoring is essential. SOC dashboards and bug bounty disclosures harden endpoints against real-world exploits.

dailyOperations.title: DPDP Act Compliance & Financial Mule Tracking
dailyOperations.sessions: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act legal requirements; RBI/SEBI security guidelines, SWIFT CSP, and mule account detection indicators.
dailyOperations.findings: Compliance standards and early cyber resilience planning protect critical infrastructure from supply chain compromise.

dailyOperations.title: Blockchain, Crypto & Real Case Investigations
dailyOperations.sessions: Blockchain architecture, public/private key cryptography; Section 91 CrPC notices, digital evidence collection, and crypto wallet tracking.
dailyOperations.findings: Blockchain transparency enables investigators to trace suspect transaction nodes across public ledgers during crypto fraud tracking.

dailyOperations.title: Data Privacy Rulings & Confidential Briefing
dailyOperations.sessions: Supreme Court Privacy Ruling (K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India); closed briefing on handling classified threat intelligence and ethics.
dailyOperations.findings: Cyber security operates under strict ethical guidelines. Integrity, confidentiality, and data safety form the basis of law enforcement.

dailyOperations.title: Offensive Security & Dark Web Investigation
dailyOperations.sessions: Red teaming workflows: system enumeration, directory brute-forcing, network port scanning, Tor onion routing mechanisms and cyber kill chain.
dailyOperations.findings: To defend systems, security analysts must think like attackers. Mapping subdomains and open ports mitigates exposure risks.

dailyOperations.title: Malware Reverse Engineering & Chip-Off Forensics
dailyOperations.sessions: Malware analysis inside isolated VMs (FlareVM/REMnux), Process Hacker, mobile physical chip extraction, hardware forensic procedures.
dailyOperations.findings: Forensic processes require strict evidence isolation. Advanced hardware chip-off recovers critical data from damaged devices.

dailyOperations.title: Mobile Acquisition, Cyber Hygiene & Ethics
dailyOperations.sessions: Mobile device acquisition standards, preserving digital proof integrity, MFA setups, strong password vaults on International Yoga Day.
dailyOperations.findings: Technical execution requires ethical responsibility. Physical and mental discipline improves decision-making in high-pressure SOC environments.

dailyOperations.title: Valedictory Defense & Certificate Reception
dailyOperations.sessions: Presented technical findings, OSINT case files, and CDR analysis reports before UP Police review panel; received official fellowship certificate.
dailyOperations.findings: Concluded 15-day fellowship with distinction. Gained strong capabilities in digital forensics, OSINT recon, and law enforcement workflows.
